name: Classical Data Augmentation Benchmark for Image Classification
description: Compares classical data augmentation methods on custom CNNs across image classification datasets to quantify their effectiveness.
reputation: A focused comparative study used as a reference for classical augmentation methods but not a widely adopted public leaderboard.
notes: Uses custom CNNs and dataset-specific evaluations; not a large-scale standardized benchmark and results are dataset/model dependent; non-LLM benchmark.
